bb4f4fc8f71b5f405f9df4e7762bf8dc706fbfd4.summary: Malwarebytes' Threat Intelligence Team reports that the actor known as Silent Librarian (also TA407 and COBALT DICKENS) has run spear phishing campaigns against universities since the 2020 academic year began. The phishing sites imitate university library and single sign-on login pages, and the actor spans many countries. The report says the actor uses Cloudflare to hide hosting and that some infrastructure sits on Iran-based hosts. bb1b36eee7a0cd45544a9757afd6de35d71e5a0d.summary: A Snort rule documentation page for alert 1:34217, a MALWARE-CNC rule for a Win.Trojan.Aytoke variant outbound connection. The rule flags a possible host infection in which the host calls out to a control server for files or other stages, or relays traffic to bot owners. The page gives no actor, sector, country, CVE or figure. Cisco Talos is listed as a contributor. The page states that there is no public information on known usage and no known false positives.
hedges: Possible existance of malware on the target host.
This may be an indication of a malware infestation.
Known Usage: No public information (no public reporting of usage)

bb9408aa613c7d6652eb0f6260337fe1805f0001.summary: Archived page listing the talks at Black Hat USA 2016 (briefings on 3 and 4 August), with abstracts on topics such as browser-to-kernel exploitation, mobile OAuth flaws, smart-light and AWS attack research, and BYOD security products. It is a conference programme index covering many unrelated talks, not a single threat report, so no facts are recorded.

bb38ec9e943645f3568e94c0b66ec04218dd65f2.summary: ESET Research describes two previously unknown backdoors, LunarWeb (HTTP(S) command and control) and LunarMail (email-based), used in compromises of a European ministry of foreign affairs and its diplomatic missions, mainly in the Middle East. ESET attributes the activity to Turla with medium confidence. Initial access is not confirmed; possible spearphishing and abuse of Zabbix monitoring software are suggested. The report says the toolset has been operational since at least 2020.
